negative_controls.note: negative controls are single-listed and never merged into the target rows

freeze_disposition: Spec 1.4 already singles out the OFF case (8 m < 13 m). Freeze options: (a) keep with this note; (b) reduce offset; (c) cancel OFF (BG and NC controls must stay).
side_pml_margin_exception.note: OFF keeps a target contrast but sits 5 m off the Tx-Rx baseline; it is a negative control for false positives, not evidence of detectability. Its lateral PML margin is below the family 13 m reference, so it is single-listed (spec §1.4/§1.5).

pairing_policy.rule: every non-BG case is differenced against the same-family same-grid BG only
